WITH period_rates AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_name,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS yr,
        CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-05-01' THEN 'q1'::text
             WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-10-31' THEN 'q2'::text
        END AS period,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL) AS total_received,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL AND on_time) AS on_time_received
    FROM v_purchasing
    WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31'
    GROUP BY supplier_name, yr, period
), rates AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'q1' THEN on_time_received::numeric / NULLIF(total_received,0) END) AS q1_rate,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'q2' THEN on_time_received::numeric / NULLIF(total_received,0) END) AS q2_rate
    FROM period_rates
    GROUP BY supplier_name
), diff AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_name,
        q1_rate,
        q2_rate,
        (q1_rate - q2_rate) AS drop_rate
    FROM rates
    WHERE q1_rate IS NOT NULL AND q2_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT supplier_name, round(drop_rate::numeric, 4) AS drop_rate
FROM diff
ORDER BY drop_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT to_char(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= date_trunc('year', current_date)
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT round((rev_oct - rev_sep)/rev_sep::numeric*100,2) AS mo_mo_growth_pct
FROM (
  SELECT month, rev,
         SUM(rev) FILTER (WHERE month='2026-10') OVER () AS rev_oct,
         SUM(rev) FILTER (WHERE month='2026-09') OVER () AS rev_sep
  FROM monthly_rev
) AS t
WHERE month='2026-10'

SELECT category AS category,
       round(SUM(margin)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(revenue),0)::numeric, 4) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC

WITH completed_sales AS (
  SELECT order_id, customer_id, revenue
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
), customer_rev AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         SUM(revenue)::numeric AS total_revenue
  FROM completed_sales
  GROUP BY customer_id
), top10 AS (
  SELECT customer_id, total_revenue
  FROM customer_rev
  ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

  FROM customer_rev
) SELECT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lower_q3_count
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS q2_rev,
         SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS q3_rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY customer_id
) sub
WHERE q2_rev > 0 AND q3_rev < q2_rev

SELECT
  category,
  round(SUM(on_hand * unit_cost)::numeric, 2) AS inventory_value_cost
FROM v_products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY inventory_value_cost DESC

SELECT product_id,
       sku,
       product_name,
       on_hand,
       unit_cost,
       round((on_hand::numeric * unit_cost)::numeric,2) AS inventory_value_cost
FROM v_products
ORDER BY inventory_value_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'paid')::numeric / count(*)::numeric * 100, 2) AS paid_percentage
FROM v_receivables
WHERE extract(year from invoice_date) = 2026

SELECT
  c.segment AS segment,
  ROUND(AVG(customer_total_rev)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rev_per_customer
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.revenue) AS customer_total_rev
  FROM v_sales s
  WHERE s.order_status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY s.customer_id
) customer_rev
JOIN v_customers c ON c.customer_id = customer_rev.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment

SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    SUM(balance) AS total_overdue_balance,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_invoices
FROM v_receivables
WHERE status = 'overdue'
GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_balance DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH revenue_periods AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN order_date >= DATE '2025-11-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'nov_dec_2025'
      WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-08-31' THEN 'jul_aug_2026'
    END AS period,
    SUM(revenue)::numeric AS total_revenue
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND (
      (order_date >= DATE '2025-11-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31')
      OR (order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-08-31')
    )
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT round(
  (SELECT total_revenue FROM revenue_periods WHERE period='nov_dec_2025')
  -
  (SELECT total_revenue FROM revenue_periods WHERE period='jul_aug_2026'),
  2
) AS revenue_diff
FROM revenue_periods
LIMIT 1

WITH sales_by_product_quarter AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        product_name,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', order_date) AS qtr,
        SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM v_sales
    WHERE order_status = 'completed'
      AND DATE_PART('year', order_date) = 2026
    GROUP BY product_id, product_name, qtr
), revenue_q2_q3 AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        product_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN qtr = DATE_TRUNC('quarter', DATE '2026-04-01') THEN total_revenue END) AS rev_q2,
        MAX(CASE WHEN qtr = DATE_TRUNC('quarter', DATE '2026-07-01') THEN total_revenue END) AS rev_q3
    FROM sales_by_product_quarter
    GROUP BY product_id, product_name
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    rev_q2,
    rev_q3,
    rev_q3 - rev_q2 AS revenue_growth
FROM revenue_q2_q3
WHERE rev_q2 IS NOT NULL AND rev_q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT round((count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_time = false)::numeric / count(*) FILTER (WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL)::numeric) * 100, 2) AS pct_late
FROM v_purchasing
WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    ROUND((SUM(margin)::numeric / SUM(revenue)::numeric) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY product_id, product_name
HAVING SUM(qty) >= 100
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 3
